newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK dept stores sales up 8.1% latest wk.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK dept stores sales up 8.1% latest wk.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said its UK department store sales rose 8.1 percent in the week to March 1 over the same week a year ago.
There was a rise of 9.2 percent in the five weeks to March 1.

Total sales, including those from the Waitrose supermarket chain, rose 6.0 percent in the week to March 1 compared with the year earlier week. There was a rise of 6.8 percent for the five week trading period.
